author: bubbubbdex
seen: A 9-second selfie lip-sync of "Erika Mercer", an AI character: shag black hair with curtain bangs, a ripped grey crop tee with a pink claw logo, filmed like a phone-camera clip in a beige room (audio: "she told me it would take ten minutes to break my heart"). The post adds her TikTok profile (26.6K followers, 143K likes in 5 days, bio "The other Mercer. iykyk"; clips include shadowboxing at 238.9K, sparring with a monk in a temple at 371.6K and a rooftop flip at 1M) and her 6-panel character sheet (front, side and back full-body + 3 portraits on grey seamless). Built with ChatGPT (look), Claude (personality and scene prompts) and Higgsfield (video). The creator claims $10K from ads in 5 days, one deal being with Higgsfield (unverified; replies doubt it). His rule: keep the face recognisable, change the situation every clip.
